_source: TFR Supply Integrity Police & Fire/NFPA Launch SKUs — validated 2026-06-29, refreshed against shopify-variant-index.json 2026-07-06.
_note: 8 Integrity SKUs, all available:true in the current Shopify export. Length, Application (Police "P" vs Fire/NFPA "F" prefix), Mount (Low Profile "L" vs Hook "H" suffix), and Color are all directly confirmed from the SKU code structure; colorConfig (single/dual/tri) is a direct restatement of that same confirmed color code for Police SKUs. Fire/NFPA SKUs (F2H) are a fixed 2-color configuration with no separate color/mount sub-selection, so they intentionally omit the color attribute — the color step passes them through regardless of selection rather than eliminating them. This corrects the prior build note, which excluded INTG44J-P1BL as nonexistent; it is present and available in the current catalog and has been added back. Control Architecture has no corresponding attribute in the real Integrity catalog and is presented as an informational step only — it does not filter the SKU list. The catalog also contains INTG44J/51J-AMBR2/AMBR3 (Work Truck, currently unavailable) — out of scope for this Police/Fire configurator. Do NOT invent prices.
